sources.snippet: Trinity Nano MLX 8bit Trinity Nano Preview is a preview of Arcee AI's 6B MoE model with 1B active parameters. It is the small-sized model in our new Trinity family, a series of open-weight models for enterprise and tinkerers alike. This is a chat tuned model, with a delightful personality and charm we think users will love.
